arguments.code:
# Test all m3 verifier conditions
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags

# Test 1: data-toc-label with entities
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
text = "# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}"
result = md.convert(text)
tok = md.toc_tokens[0]

assert tok['name'] == 'Custom & Label', f"name mismatch: {tok['name']!r}"
assert '&' in tok['html'], f"html missing &: {tok['html']!r}"
assert tok['data-toc-label'] == 'Custom & Label', f"data-toc-label mismatch: {tok['data-toc-label']!r}"
assert 'custom-label' in tok['id'], f"id mismatch: {tok['id']!r}"
print("Test 1 passed: data-toc-label with entities")

# Test 2: heading without data-toc-label
md2 = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc'])
text2 = "# Hello World"
result2 = md2.convert(text2)
tok2 = md2.toc_tokens[0]
assert tok2['name'] == 'Hello World', f"name mismatch: {tok2['name']!r}"
assert tok2['id'] == 'hello-world', f"id mismatch: {tok2['id']!r}"
assert 'html' in tok2, "missing html key"
assert 'data-toc-label' in tok2, "missing data-toc-label key"
print("Test 2 passed: normal heading")

# Test 3: heading with footnote reference
md3 = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes'])
text3 = "# Header with footnote[^1]\n\n[^1]: text"
result3 = md3.convert(text3)
tok3 = md3.toc_tokens[0]
assert 'footnote' in tok3['name'].lower() or tok3['name'] == 'Header with footnote', f"name should not have trailing 1: {tok3['name']!r}"
print(f"Test 3 passed: footnote ref stripped - name={tok3['name']!r}")

# Test 4: multiple keys present
for k in ['level', 'id', 'name', 'html', 'data-toc-label']:
    assert k in tok, f"missing key: {k}"
print("Test 4 passed: all required keys present")

print("\nAll m3 tests passed!")
